title: Understanding the Graph
text: Notice how the error changes as the regularization parameter lambda increases. Think about how bias and variance are affected by regularization.

title: Bias and Variance
text: Remember that increasing regularization tends to increase bias and decrease variance. How does this relate to the curves labeled A and B?

hintAnswer: (A) is the error due to $${Bias}^2$$ and (B) is the error due to Model Variance.
title: Identifying Curve A
text: Which error component typically increases with more regularization?
choices: (A) is the Test Error and (B) is the error due to $${Bias}^2$$.
